# Structured Analysis of Photosynthesis in Plants
---
## 1. Core Definition & Overall Reaction
Photosynthesis is the energy-converting anabolic process unique to photoautotrophs (plants, algae, cyanobacteria) that transforms sunlight energy into stable chemical energy stored in organic molecules (e.g., glucose). It is the foundation of nearly all terrestrial and aquatic food webs.
The balanced overall reaction is:
$$6CO_2 + 6H_2O + \text{light energy} \rightarrow C_6H_{12}O_6 \, (\text{glucose}) + 6O_2$$

---
## 2. Structural Basis of Plant Photosynthesis
Photosynthesis occurs exclusively in chloroplasts, with specialized compartments for each stage of the reaction:
- **Chlorophyll & accessory pigments**: Embedded in thylakoid membranes, these pigments (chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, carotenoids)
